messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a small runtime kernel + quant tweak tonight 23:00 UTC (30m slot). Need an owner for deploy + smoke + rollback readiness. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/5234

maria: I can take deploy owner if @ken can do smoke checks and perf traces. Slot works for me.

ken: sg. I'll run the smoke script and watch p99. What's the canary slice size? 2 nodes ok?

alex: Canary = slice-c2 (2 pods). Profile = q2-light (low-bit quant). Quick notes: 5m stabilization after canary deploy before any ramp. Also we need KV-cache warm step.

maria: noted. I'll start canary at 23:00, wait 5m, then ramp to 20% at 23:10 if clean. I'll post status updates in-thread.

ken: I'll run a small load probe from eu-west-1: 20 RPS for 60s, check p50/p95/p99 and token-cost impact. Smoke checklist below.

ken: ```bash
# canary smoke (run after slice-c2 passes health)
./scripts/deploy-canary --slice slice-c2 --image runtime:v1.12-quant-q2-light
sleep 30
# warm kv cache
curl -s https://slice-c2.internal/_warm | head -n 3
# simple probe
wrk -t2 -c10 -d60s -R20 http://slice-c2.internal/generate
# health check
curl -sS https://slice-c2.internal/health | jq .status
```

sam: I'll be on-call during the window and watching the console + traces. If error-rate > 0.5% or p99 > 250ms for > 2m we rollback. We'll give a 10m rollback grace after any major warning.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deployment window scheduled 2026-03-17T23:00Z -> 2026-03-17T23:30Z. Ping @alex when starting. :bell:

maria: Process: start canary -> wait 5m -> run ken's smoke -> if green ramp to 20% -> 10m soak -> then roll remainder if stable. I'll annotate rollout steps in the orchestration UI.

ken: Quick rollback command (if we need fast revert):
`./orchestrator rollback --to-tag runtime:v1.11 --force --slices=all`

alex: Add-ons: toggle debug logging for 5m if we need deeper traces: set runtime.log.level=debug in the slice config and revert after. Also confirm quant flag in cluster config: runtime.quant.profile=q2-light.

maria: PR contains the config flip and a small unit test for kv-warm. Link in PR description. I'll flip the flag during canary only.

sam: I'll monitor infra alerts and keep the rollback path ready. If anyone sees anomalous token-cost or malformed outputs, call rollback and @sam will action.

alex: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll post a "starting" message 5m prior and again at kickoff. Keep updates short (ok / fail / rolling back).

ken: :eyes: also I'll enable short-term sampling for traces (1%) to reduce noise but capture spans if things go weird.

maria: understood — will do.
